- Parent flex container uses `align-items: center` 
- Icons and text are vertically centered relative to each other

- The `.zcc-result` card specifically needs `align-items: center` (not flex-start)

Also check the theme editor preview block CSS (the static HTML preview near the top of the file) for any mismatches with the live widget CSS.

Make the edits. Keep changes minimal and targeted.
